title: Physical HotBar
description: This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel. Items in your inventory has physics.
body:
This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel.
Items in your inventory are no longer static images. They react to your player's movement physics. When you jump, items bounce up; when you run, they squash and stretch inside their GUI slots based on your momentum.
